title: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer
text:
AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer

['From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2028-07-18T16:10:00Z\\nSubject: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer\\n\\nHi Sara and team,\\n\\nThanks again for the time earlier — excited to get the CloudDocs offer ready for AWS Marketplace. Attached is our first-pass product page copy and the draft AMI/SKU mapping (clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx, ami_mapping.csv).\\n\\nQuick asks so we can lock the listing this week:\\n- Can you confirm the three pricing tiers you want displayed (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) and whether the Starter tier should show a 14-day trial?\\n- Confirm which AMI IDs we should surface vs internal-only (see column C in ami_mapping.csv).\\n- Any objections to the benefit statement in the hero: “Secure, low-latency document search with on-prem parity”? We want something concise but defensible for marketplace review.\\n- AWS PM: can you confirm co-sell badge eligibility and any extra metadata (ISV Accelerator, Sales Connect) we should include?\\n\\nTarget: aim to submit to AWS by EOD Friday (2028-07-21) so we have time for the listing review cycle.\\n\\nAttachments: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx (proposed product page copy), ami_mapping.csv (SKU/AMI mapping).\\n\\nThanks — I’ll consolidate feedback and circulate a final stub for signing.\\n\\nBest,\\nTessa Morgan\\nSenior Partner Sales Manager\\nRedwood Inference\\n---\\nAttachment stubs: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx (edit suggestions welcome), ami_mapping.csv (CSV, 12 rows)', 'From: Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com>\\nTo: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>\\nCc: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>\\nDate: 2028-07-19T09:04:00Z\\nSubject: Re: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer\\n\\nTessa — thanks, this looks great. Quick clarifications: \\n- Pricing: Starter = $0.00 (free trial for 14 days), Growth = $0.10/MAU, Enterprise = contact us for pricing. We also want a monthly and annual toggle if possible.\\n- AMIs: we’ll expose the public AMI (ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8) and keep the accelerated-quantized AMI internal for now. I added notes in the CSV.\\n- Hero claim: fine but can we soften to “Secure, low-latency document search designed for enterprise workloads”? Avoid saying \\"on-prem parity\\" — compliance team flagged the phrase.\\n\\nWe also want to request a Private Offer option for our pilot customers — can you add that to the listing notes?\\n\\nHappy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.\\n\\nBest,\\nSara Patel\\nHead of Cloud Partnerships\\nCloudDocs Inc.\\n\\nOn Jul 18, 2028, at 16:10, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> [original message attached]\\n\\n---\\nNote: Sara attached a short procurement timeline separately to her reply (not included).', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>\\nTo: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com>\\nCc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2028-07-20T14:35:00Z\\nSubject: Re: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer\\n\\nThanks Sara — good catches. I pulled the product page into Word and added inline copy suggestions (clouddocs_aws_listing_v1_kp_comments.docx). Highlights: \\n- Hero: updated to \\"Secure, low-latency document search designed for enterprise workloads\\" per compliance note.\\n- Bullets: tightened 3 benefit bullets to be metric-forward (e.g., \\"Reduce avg. search latency to <200ms for 90% of queries\\"). Keep one plain-language bullet.\\n- Trial language: recommend we show the 14-day trial on Starter but add a CTA to contact sales for Enterprise (AWS requires clear trial terms).\\n- Pricing toggle: note for AWS PM — we should include both monthly and annual price points in the price table; that\'s supported but it must be in the metering section.\\n\\nJonas — added a TODO to confirm co-sell eligibility flags and whether CloudDocs qualifies for the AWS ISV Accelerate program; can you confirm partner-side?\\n\\nI also added an FAQ snippet about data residency and logging so marketplace reviewers have quick answers.\\n\\nK\\n\\n--\\nKimberly Park\\nMarketplace & Field Playback Lead\\nRedwood Inference\\nAttachment: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1_kp_comments.docx (tracked changes, ~8 comments)\\n\\nOn Jul 19, 2028, Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com> wrote:\\n> [previous message]', "From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>\\nTo: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>\\nCc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com>\\nDate: 2028-07-22T13:02:00Z\\nSubject: Fwd: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer\\n\\n---------- Forwarded message ----------\\nFrom: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>\\nTo: internal distribution\\nDate: 2028-07-22T13:01:00Z\\nSubject: CloudDocs co-sell readiness checklist (quick)\\n\\nHi AWS Marketplace team — forwarding the thread and updated copy. Short checklist from our side for co-sell enablement: \\n- Confirm ISV Accelerate eligibility (CloudDocs pilot footprint meets the criteria; they have a sales playbook).\\n- Confirm we can surface a Private Offer CTA and link to the PrivateOffer flow.\\n- Confirm metering info: Growth tier uses usage-based metering (MAU), Starter is free trial, Enterprise is custom. Please advise on required metering fields.\\n- Co-sell assets: we will provide a one-page one-pager and a short demo recording. Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/CDD-2028-1074\\n\\nAttachments in the thread: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx, clouddocs_aws_listing_v1_kp_comments.docx, ami_mapping.csv\\n\\nJonas Weber\\nPartner GTM, Redwood Inference\\n\\n---------- End forwarded message ----------\\n\\nJonas here — can you confirm the three items above and any required schema changes to the metering table? If there's a specific field name AWS expects for Private Offer routing we can add it to the CSV before submission.\\n\\nThanks,\\nJonas\\n\\n---\\nNote: This was the final message in the thread; Jonas attached the finalized copy bundle to the forward and linked the HubSpot deal for AWS intake staff."]
